prior_findings.R1: Resolved: all negatives now require branch-specific traceback markers, expected journal state/check count and physical invocation directory count; process/output cases require matching physical injection artifacts. A generic nonzero exit alone cannot qualify a control.
prior_findings.R2: Resolved by explicit scope: post-run owner replacement expects the git cleanliness guard and matching changed owner bytes; no claim of reaching the digest comparison.

checked_design_details: Second output mismatch changes y, mu and RMSE consistently, so scalar checker passes before explicit numerical replay refusal; exactly two captured rows/directories required.
Missing/malformed/extra/symlink output controls require one captured row, intended rejection line/type and matching physical output shape.
Nonzero exit requires code7 in captured row; stderr requires exact retained controlled diagnostic.
Deadline requires Timeout in persisted failure, the actual supervisor call in traceback, zero captured rows, one invocation directory and absent stdout capture.

Pre-execution source/runtime guards require zero invocation directories and matching guard/error markers. Top-level checker/protocol guards require absent journal; preexisting journal must remain exact.
Preexisting invocation requires FileExistsError, zero captured rows and no newly created output subdirectory.
Positive requires two successful captured rows and directories; unchanged adapter independently enforces numerical replay and final success.
Historical adapter/checker bytes remain copied unchanged; synthetic generated scripts, two one-file Git roots and one-marker runtime are clearly labeled as fixtures.
remaining_requirements: Execute under owning lease using the reviewed exact script bytes; retain script hash, every raw stdout/stderr, fixture inputs and qualification row.
Treat failed assertions, setup exceptions or harness timeouts as incomplete/failed qualification; retain outputs and revise in a new destination rather than overwrite.
After execution independently inspect actual per-case evidence; this preexecution approval does not state any control has passed.

These are synthetic capture-adapter controls, not new scientific runner observations, full3270-runtime tamper coverage, current source-pair evidence, OU dynamics, native acceptance or Issue61 closure.
nonblocking_limits: Some traceback markers identify source assertions rather than custom reason codes; the matching physical artifact, phase and row/directory counts provide adequate disambiguation for these controlled fixtures.
Unexpected fixture-setup/harness parsing failures may stop before the next qualification row, but cannot be falsely reported as passing; prior rows/raw artifacts remain.
